## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `da46dafac5dd78e22357b5e029c0a801147a08fa`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/agents/os-dev.md + scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs, scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs, AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist ③), .github/workflows/pr-automation.yml (`Check Changeset` job), docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md, pnpm-workspace.yaml (`onlyBuiltDependencies`), scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (ceiling map)

Written 2026-10-23T07:08Z. Review of draft PR #25393 (Fixes #25220) against `origin/main` at `5f6c2f19` (the PR's base), diff taken from the merge-base `fc7b53ff`: one file, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, +2/−2, 404 → 404 lines. Spec read: card #25220 body (Ask + Acceptance), the seat-1 handover comment 6343602884 (2026-10-22T14:45Z) carrying the carry-over reword, and the seat's claim 6359244707 (2026-10-23T06:50Z). Angle-bracket placeholders in the quoted Chinese below are spelled `N` instead of the file's literal form, because the body sanitizer eats tag-shaped fragments; the file itself keeps its spelling.

### ① Derived judgments

Face: governed rules text (`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` is protocol semantics per `dispatch-gates --tier`: MANDATORY, clause ①). No published schema, no `packages/spec/src/**`, no Tier H path: the only path is under `.claude/**`, which os-dev.md L287 and AGENTS.md Prime Directive 14 put in Tier S. `Governed Surface Queue Guard` on the head: success.

**(a) The exemption line, 〈干净收尾〉 L323 (new, 118 bytes):** 「- 例外:harness 自写的 PR 正文首行归属注释原样留、只报;`Fixes #N` 紧随其后;dev 自写仍禁。」 — CORRECT, with one wording note in ③.
- Shape: it mirrors the existing harness-trailer exemption at L286 「harness 自写含模型名 trailer 只报,⛔ 不仿不改史」: harness-written, keep verbatim, report it (只报), and the dev's own writing stays under the ban (dev 自写仍禁). Scope is bounded three ways — harness-written, PR body, first-line attribution comment — so nothing else in the ban at L321–322 is loosened; L18 「⛔ 不用 HTML 注释写标记」 (the report marker) and L324 (angle-bracket spellings) are untouched.
- Consistency with L274 「Draft PR 指向 `main`,正文首行 `Fixes #N`」: L274 stays unconditional, but L323 is labelled 例外 and itself re-places `Fixes #N`, so a reader has a specific rule (harness block present ⇒ `Fixes` follows it) over a general one (otherwise line 1). The card accepted either "say it" or "point to the rule"; this line says it. Not two contradicting rules — but L274 is now a general rule with an exception stated 49 lines away; see ③ for the stale sibling in the PM-side checklist.
- Measured against a real harness-attributed body (PR #25214): line 1 is the HTML comment, line 2 is the `_Requested by_` line, line 3 blank, line 4 `Fixes`. The new line names only the first-line comment as what is kept; the second line is not an HTML comment and needs no exemption. 「紧随其后」 reads "right after it"; the measured placement is "first line after the block". Precision note, not a defect: the harness itself hands the dev the block, and the only sanctioned action on it is 原样留. ③ carries a ratchet-neutral alternative spelling.

**(b) The changeset-line reword, L280 (in place, 111 bytes):** old 「- 两行同抄进每个 changeset 正文行首,`Check Changeset` 读:有 kind 即 `minor`,`none` 即 `patch`。」 → new 「- 两行同抄进 changeset 正文行首;`Check Changeset` 读 PR 正文:kind 即 `minor`,`none` 即 `patch`。」 — CORRECT.
- `Check Changeset` is the `changeset-check` job in `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml` L244, running `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`. Its `declarationFromPullRequest(pr)` (L1808) reads both lines off the PR body: `readClause2Line(pr.body ?? '')` at L1818 and `readMetadataProtocolLine(pr.body ?? '')` at L1843; the only caller is L2861 over the event payload's `pull_request`. Neither reader is applied to a changeset file anywhere in that script, so the old sentence (the gate reads the changeset copy) was the misstatement the carry-over named, and the new one is what the code does.
- The changeset-body copy survives as the first clause; its owner is AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist ③ ("Two line-initial declarations, in the PR body and the changeset body … the changeset body, which also carries both declaration lines (`pnpm check:adr-0087-registration` reads the arm and the kind there)"). Dropping 「每个」 loses nothing: the clause still says every changeset body carries them (Chinese is numberless; AGENTS.md ③ says the same without "each").
- 「有 kind 即 `minor`」 → 「kind 即 `minor`」: no meaning lost. In the gate's own vocabulary "kind" is the closed set `added|narrowed|semantic` as opposed to `none` (`METADATA_PROTOCOL_KINDS` in `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` L515; the remedy text at `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` L2302: "`none` is `patch`, a kind is `minor`"; the banner at L2173–2174: a kind takes at least `minor` on a moved package, `none` takes `patch`). The `(narrowing)` arm also shipping `minor` (L1838) was not in the old line either; unchanged simplification.

**(c) The payment line, Toolchain traps L128 (deleted, 111 bytes):** 「- `cdn.playwright.dev` 的 403 不是没有浏览器的证据:下载被拦不证明产物缺席,先找产物。」 — the deletion is SOUND; no guidance a dev can act on is lost.
- When can a dev here see a `cdn.playwright.dev` 403 at all? Only by downloading browsers. The two surviving lines (L126–127) say Chromium is preinstalled at `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH`=`/opt/pw-browsers`, say to launch with `executablePath: '/opt/pw-browsers/chromium'`, and ban `playwright install` outright. The other download route, a `playwright`/`@playwright/test` postinstall, does not run: pnpm 10.31 (`packageManager`) runs dependency build scripts only for `pnpm-workspace.yaml` `onlyBuiltDependencies` (`better-sqlite3`, `esbuild`, `mongodb-memory-server`, `msw`, `sharp`) and playwright is not among them; the workspace's own deps are `playwright-core` (no downloader) in service-print and dogfood, and `@playwright/test` only in `examples/app-showcase`.
- The failure a dev actually meets is the launch error `Executable doesn't exist at …/chromium_headless_shell-1243/…` (RUNNER.md L210–225: the package wants build 1243, the image holds 1194), whose remedy is exactly the surviving `executablePath` line. The deleted line's remedy 「先找产物」 is already answered more concretely by L126 (where the artefact is). Its epistemic half (a blocked download is not evidence of absence) is reachable only after a dev has already broken the ⛔ on the line above it; a rule for the reader who ignores the adjacent ⛔ is not guidance the file owes. The generic lesson also survives on the PM side at `references/platform-readings.md` L270–271 (「被拦的下载不是缺席证明:出口策略 403 只说取不来,不说没有,先找产物再下结论。」 plus the reading).
- Origin of the line: `git log -S` reaches only `60b42cd0b` (the commit at this shallow clone's boundary, which shows the whole file as added), so its true landing commit is NOT MEASURED here; the judgment above rests on the current text and the current toolchain facts, not on its history.

**Ratchet and lints:** ceiling map `['.claude/agents/os-dev.md', 404]` untouched; `wc -l` 404 on the head (404 on main); every changed line ≤120 bytes (118, 111, 111, 111); no `#` followed by 3+ digits in any added line (id-lint pattern); the 120-byte long-line allowance for this file stays 0. `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` on the head: success (the ratchet and id-lint families run there). The standing rule 「必须人工决裁」 lives in `references/lanes/director.md`, not in os-dev.md on either side of the diff, so it is untouched by construction.

**PR form:** draft, base `main`, body line 1 `Fixes #25220` (the card is fully delivered by this PR: exemption + carry-over, so a closing keyword is right), `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on lines 2–3, no HTML comment in the body (an in-seat subagent has no harness attribution block), no other open card number near a closing keyword. Labels `skip-changeset` + `domain:skills` as the claim planned. `pr_create` carried the attribution; no `PATCH`.

### ② Semver level

`.claude/**` publishes nothing (os-dev.md L299 fast-track list; AGENTS.md ③), the diff moves no `files[]` content of any `private: false` package, so `skip-changeset` is the correct declaration and no changeset is owed. `Clause-②: no` (no accept set or public surface moves) and `Metadata-protocol: none` match the diff. `Check Changeset` on the head: success (the label fast path). No `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm ⇒ no dogfood battery owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Independence: implementer and reviewer are both this seat's subagents (in-seat S card per the claim's `Container & model` line and handover 6343602884: S mechanical cards run in the seat). `Implemented-by` is the seat thread's designated push branch, `Reviewed-by` the seat session; the adversarial-brief shape was kept (diff, card, handover, claim and head check-runs only; no dispatch order, no dev self-assessment).
- Wording note on (a), for the seat, not a fix owed before landing: 「紧随其后」 vs the measured "first line after the block". A ratchet-neutral alternative within 120 bytes, if the seat wants the block named: 「- 例外:harness 自写的 PR 正文开头归属块原样留、只报;`Fixes #N` 紧随块后;dev 自写仍禁。」 (115 bytes with the literal placeholder). Not a FAIL: the harness hands the dev the block and 原样留 is the only sanctioned action on it.
- Follow-up outside this PR's file surface: L274 「正文首行 `Fixes #N`」 stays unconditional, and the PM-side `references/review-checklist.md` L7 「正文首行引用卡片」 has no exemption at all, so a seat checking a project-thread PR by that line still reads line 1 as the carrier. Carrier: the owning seat decides whether a card is worth a line there.
- Dev-side `deviations`/`open_questions`: none flagged in the PR body; the body's own risk line (the deleted 403 lesson) is answered in ①(c).
- Check-runs on the head, read via the API 2026-10-23T07:08Z: 50 check runs, all `completed`, none failed (`success` or `skipped`); the required floor `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check` both `success`; `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, the two single-claim guards and `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` all `success`. An earlier reading at 2026-10-23T07:06Z still had seven lint/type-check jobs `in_progress`; this record waited for them. The verdict below is on the diff; the check reading is the landing gate's second condition, stated here for the seat.
